content.text: {"narrative":[{"claim":"Fragmented definitions, reporting formats and data systems had made it difficult to measure progress consistently and spotlight inequalities in India.","cites":["risk:43"]},{"claim":"The Government of India launched the Swachh Bharat (Clean India) Mission in 2014.","cites":["fact:01a126fa-f219-73f4-a4c6-4df3ca83d863"]},{"claim":"110 million toilets were constructed under the Swachh Bharat Mission.","cites":["kpi:143"]},{"claim":"India reached 580 million people with improved drinking water and 550 million people with basic sanitation in the last 10 years.","cites":["kpi:140","kpi:139"]},{"claim":"In 2024, 59.3 million people accessed safely managed water and 17.9 million people accessed safely managed sanitation in India.","cites":["kpi:147","kpi:146"]},{"claim":"The Government of India invested over $120 billion in water and sanitation.","cites":["kpi:142"]}]}
